retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black and white portrait framed by textured earthy borders with layered gold typography combining geometric sans and elegant script.
triggerTerms: monochrome portrait with textured side panels
gold geometric sans serif over black and white photo

recipe.visualDefinition: A central vertical black and white close-up portrait of a person with eyes closed and a joyful expression, flanked by two vertical borders featuring a reddish-brown stone or parchment texture. The composition is anchored by large, thin gold sans-serif text at the top and bottom, with a delicate calligraphic script line cutting through the lower third.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between monochrome subject and warm-toned textured borders
Hierarchy established by large-scale name typography framing the face
Intersection of rigid geometric letters and fluid script strokes
Balance between the dark shadows of the portrait and the bright gold of the text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up portrait centered vertically, filling the middle 60% of the horizontal space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the highlighted cheek and mouth area.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow from the large upper name, through the facial expression, to the script line, and finally the lower name.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows within the portrait and the solid textured blocks on the left and right.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the portrait; low saturation in the borders to maintain a sophisticated, earthy feel.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to monochrome, gold, and earth tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric Sans Serif and Copperplate-style Script
letterConstructionRules: Sans-serif: high waist, thin strokes, wide proportions
Script: extreme contrast between thick and thin, long flourishing swashes
Small caps: used for secondary descriptive text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' and 'A' in the sans-serif have wide, open stances
The script 'S', 'T', 'N', 'M' feature extended decorative loops
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rigid, modern geometric sans and a traditional, flowing formal script.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal lines separating text elements

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, wide-set proportions of the primary display text.
Provides the necessary calligraphic contrast and elegant swashes.
Appropriate for the small-caps secondary text elements.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vertical composition with a central black and white soulful portrait of a person with eyes closed and a smile. Flank the portrait with two vertical sidebars featuring a reddish-brown stone or mottled paper texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply gold-colored typography. Place a large, wide geometric sans-serif name at the top and bottom. Overlay a delicate, flowing calligraphic script title across the lower third, extending into the sidebars.

verificationChecks: Are the sidebars textured and earthy in tone?
Does the gold text have a subtle metallic sheen?
Is the script text legible against the portrait background?

adjustableVariables: Texture of the side borders (stone, paper, wood)
Width of the central portrait vs. sidebars
Intensity of the gold metallic effect
mustRedesign: Do not replicate exact brand logos
Ensure the script flourishes do not obscure vital facial features
postGenerationChecks: Verify the three-column vertical structure is intact
Check that the gold text is centered and balanced
Ensure the script font has high contrast in stroke weight
Confirm the background texture is visible but not distracting
recipe.reuseFormula: Vertical tri-panel layout + B&W portrait + Textured margins + Gold geometric/script pairing.
